intervention.name: QUERY_LOCAL_CODE_PAIR_MASS_PRESERVING
intervention.principal_difference: Within the 48 PRIMARY_CONNECTED_COMPONENT_COUNT slots only, elevate the corrected zero-based Count code cells (1,1) and (1,2) in the final query assistant answer only. Do not elevate the corresponding three demonstration-answer code pairs.
intervention.loss_mass: The selected two-token query code pair is upweighted by 2.0 and every other valid assistant token is compensated so each Count slot keeps its Equal-Slot scalar mass.

predeclared_discrimination.conditional_binding: If E4-B Marker Binding harm is caused by elevated unconditioned demonstration codes, query-local Code-Pair should remove the Marker Binding retention loss while preserving or improving Count train fit.
predeclared_discrimination.object_centric_representation: If the intervention still improves only train fit but not structural OOD, its decision-token emphasis does not create object-centric Count representations.
predeclared_discrimination.atomic_to_compositional_transfer: If composition stays unchanged despite Count train-fit improvement, the gain remains an atomic answer-code association rather than compositional transfer.

falsifiers: Marker Binding retention remains below Equal-Slot despite no demonstration-code emphasis.
Train fit improves but the independently frozen structural OOD effect remains below the predeclared causal gate.
Composition changes despite the intervention touching only Count primary loss.
